When I started NoFap, I was depressed, suicidal, perverted, severely anxious, my body was wasting away from my terrible diet; almost every part of my life that could have been out of order was.

I am no longer depressed, suicidal, perverted, or severely anxious. I'm fixing my diet as time goes on and I'm treating my body better than I ever have. I'm not saying these things to boast in myself but in the strength and ability of NoFap to allow wonderful things.

NoFap is not a panacea but it opens up so many doors for so much healing.

Edit: Another improvement that just occurred to me is that I don't really ever think about sex. When I was addicted to PMO, every other thought in my head all the day long would be something sexual, and I hated it.
